readout_other: GCaMP6f calcium imaging; tetrodotoxin and synaptic-blocker controls
direction_notes: Calcium fluorescence rose in cultured cortical neurons near the emitter at 56 and 65 uJ pulse energy; 46 uJ gave negligible response.
safety_notes: Repeated stimulation of the same area three times in 4 min gave repeatable responses, taken as no damage; temperature rise about 10 um from the emitter was up to 1.15 C.

exposures.label: Candle soot fiber optoacoustic emitter on cultured cortical neurons

timing.protocol_description: Optoacoustic stimulation: 3 ns laser pulses at 1030 nm and 1.7 kHz repetition rate, delivered as a 3 ms train of 5 pulses per stimulation, with pulse energy 46, 56 or 65 uJ. Each laser pulse produces a broadband bipolar acoustic transient centred at 12.8 MHz.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Based on the frequency analysis of ultrasound signal generated, CSFOE emitted broadband high-frequency ultrasound centered at 12.8 MHz.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: These laser conditions correspond to optoacoustic pressure of 8.8 MPa and 12.4 MPa at the peak of frequency of 12.8 MHz for CSFOE.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: A 3 ns pulsed laser at 1030 nm with a repetition rate of 1.7 kHz was delivered to the CSFOE.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The laser pulse train, with a duration of 3 ms (corresponding to 5 pulses) and pulse energy of 65 µJ, was used for CSFOE optoacoustic in vitro neural stimulation.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: In this work, we developed a candle soot-based fiber optoacoustic emitter (CSFOE) for the first time.

flags.reason: Peak-to-peak pressures measured by hydrophone in water for the laser conditions of 56 uJ (8.8 MPa) and 65 uJ (12.4 MPa); the list holds these two conditions, not a range. The text also gives about 8 MPa as the activation threshold and 10 to 15 MPa as device maxima.
ISPPA and ISPTA were calculated by the authors from the peak-to-peak pressure of 12.4 MPa and the 1.7 kHz repetition rate, not measured; the paper's duty cycle is not stated.
Laser-generated optoacoustic transients rather than a sinusoidal carrier; recorded as other_patterned.
Only the 3 ns laser pulse duration is stated; the acoustic transient duration is not given.
Cultures from three batches or dishes are mentioned; neuron counts (N=10 to 30) are per group; no total number of cultures is stated.
Emitter fabricated by the authors; no commercial maker. Scope note: an optoacoustic fiber emitter rather than a piezoelectric transducer.
